name: Lam rice
summary: Cơm lam is sticky rice grilled in a young bamboo tube and served with peanut salt. Vietnam Tourism says restaurants sell it, and so do street vendors. A vendor’s street was not named. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den. Vietnam Tourism describes the tube. Báo Kon Tum names cơm lam at the cultural-night meal.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism puts sticky rice into baby bamboo tubes, grills the tubes, and serves them with peanut salt.
Eat it from a restaurant or from a street vendor. The street was not named.
A price is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
where: Restaurants in town, and street vendors, on the Vietnam Tourism discover article. No street name.
Báo Kon Tum names cơm lam with gà nướng, thịt xiên, bánh nếp, and rượu cần at the cultural night.
